ntlm.title: On-premise Exchange (NTLM)
ntlm.description: Enter your Exchange server details and credentials.

data_description.username: Leave empty to use email address

basic.title: Basic Authentication (EWS)
basic.description: Enter your EWS server details and credentials. Use this for AWS WorkMail and other servers that use Basic authentication.

data_description.username: Leave empty to use email address

cba.title: On-premise Exchange (Certificate)
cba.description: Enter your Exchange server details and the path to the client certificate. The PEM file must contain both the certificate and the private key.

data.key_path: Path to private key (optional, if separate)

data_description.key_path: Absolute path, only needed if key is in a separate file

oauth2.title: Office 365 (Graph API)
oauth2.description: Enter your Azure AD application credentials. Required Application permissions: Calendars.ReadWrite and User.Read.All (with admin consent).

data_description.tenant_id: Found in Azure AD > App registrations > Overview
data_description.client_id: Found in Azure AD > App registrations > Overview
data_description.client_secret: Found in Azure AD > App registrations > Certificates & secrets

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Exchange
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {email} are no longer valid (the password may have expired). Enter the new credentials to reconnect.

reconfigure.title: Change Exchange credentials
reconfigure.description: Update the stored credentials for {email} without removing the integration.

abort.already_configured: This Exchange account is already configured.

data_description.calendars: Select which of your calendars are exposed as entities. Each selected calendar becomes its own calendar entity.
